# Silmatervis — KSA Silmakeskus eye health education platform

> Silmatervis is the patient education platform of KSA Silmakeskus (KSA Vision
> Clinic), Estonia's leading refractive eye surgery centre. It explains eye
> conditions, eye anatomy, procedures and treatments in plain language, with
> medical video from Rendia. Content is reviewed by Dr Ants Haavel,
> ophthalmologist. Languages: English, Estonian, Russian.

## About

- **Platform:** https://silmatervis.ksa.ee
- **Clinic:** KSA Silmakeskus (KSA Vision Clinic), Tallinn and Tartu, Estonia
- **Main site:** https://ksa.ee
- **Clinic facts:** https://ksa.ee/ksa-faktid/
- **Blog:** https://blog.ksa.ee
- **Medical authority:** Dr Ants Haavel, ophthalmologist and refractive surgeon. https://www.linkedin.com/in/ants-haavel-2066366
- **Pages:** 110 education pages across four categories

## Eye anatomy

- [The Cornea (Front of the Eye)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/cornea): The cornea is the clear, curved front part of your eye. It helps focus light so you can see clearly.
- [The Lens (Inside Your Eye)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/lens-eye): The lens is a clear, flexible part inside your eye that focuses light. It changes shape to help you see things at different distances.
- [The Retina (Back of Your Eye)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/retina): The retina is light-sensitive tissue at the back of your eye. It captures light and sends signals to your brain to create vision.
- [The Pupil and Iris](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/pupil-iris): The iris is the colored part of your eye. The pupil is the black opening in the center that lets light in.
- [The Optic Nerve](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/optic-nerve): The optic nerve is like an electrical cable connecting the eye to the brain. It transmits vision signals from the retina.
- [Vitreous Humor (Clear Gel / Vitreous Body)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/vitreous-humor): The Vitreous Humor (clear gel, or vitreous body) is the thick, clear fluid inside the eye between the lens and the retina that helps the eye keep i…
- [Aqueous Humor (Clear Fluid in Front of Lens / Anterior Chamber Fluid)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/aqueous-humor): The Aqueous Humor (clear fluid in front of lens, or anterior chamber fluid) is the watery fluid that fills the space between the cornea and lens an…
- [Ciliary Body (Focusing Muscle / Accommodation Mechanism)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/ciliary-body): The Ciliary Body (focusing muscle, or accommodation mechanism) is the muscle that changes the lens shape so you can focus on objects at different d…
- [The Sclera (White of the Eye)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/sclera): The sclera is the tough, white outer coating of the eye. It protects the delicate parts inside.
- [Extraocular Muscles (Eye Movement Muscles / Ocular Muscles)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/extraocular-muscles): The Extraocular Muscles (eye movement muscles, or ocular muscles) are six muscles attached to the eye that let you move your eyes in different dire…
- [The Tear System (Tear Production and Drainage)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/tear-system): The tear system produces, spreads, and drains tears. Tears protect and lubricate the eye.
- [Retinal Blood Vessels (Retinal Vasculature / Retinal Circulation)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/retinal-blood-vessels): Retinal Blood Vessels (retinal vasculature, or retinal circulation) are tiny blood vessels that supply oxygen and nutrients to the retina. retinal…
- [Macula and Fovea (Central Retina / Sharp Vision Area)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/macula-fovea): The Macula and Fovea (central retina, or sharp vision area) are the most sensitive parts of the retina where you see fine detail and color. the mac…
- [Anterior Chamber Angle (Drainage Angle / Iridocorneal Angle)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/anterior-chamber-angle): The Anterior Chamber Angle (drainage angle, or iridocorneal angle) is where fluid (aqueous humor) drains out of the eye through the trabecular mesh…
- [The Conjunctiva and Eyelid](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/conjunctiva-eyelid): The conjunctiva is a thin membrane covering the white of the eye and inside of eyelids. The eyelid protects the eye.
- [Ciliary Muscles (Accommodation Muscles / Ciliaris Muscle)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/ciliary-muscles): Ciliary muscles (also called accommodation muscles or ciliary body) are small muscles inside your eye that change the shape of your lens. They help…
- [Eye Blood Vessels (Retinal Vasculature / Ophthalmic Circulation)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/blood-vessels-eye): Blood vessels in your eye deliver oxygen and nutrients to keep your vision working. These tiny vessels (called retinal vasculature or ophthalmic ci…
- [Tear Film (Lacrimal Film / Tear Layers)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/tear-film-layers): Your tear film is a thin, layered coating that covers your eye. It has three layers: oil (lipid), water (aqueous), and mucus (mucin). Each layer se…
- [Ocular Surface (Eye Surface / Anterior Eye)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/ocular-surface): The ocular surface is the outermost part of your eye that you can see—it includes the cornea, conjunctiva (white part), and eyelids. This surface i…
- [Eyelash Follicles (Lash Roots / Cilia)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/eyelash-follicles): Eyelash follicles are tiny structures that grow and anchor your eyelashes (cilia). Each follicle has its own oil gland. When these follicles get in…
- [Lacrimal Glands (Tear Glands / Lacrimal System)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/lacrimal-glands): Lacrimal glands are small glands above your eye that produce tears. Tears keep your eyes moist, comfortable, and protected. When these glands don't…
- [Eyebrow (Superciliary Arch / Brow Ridge)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/brow-ridge): Eyebrows (superciliary arch) are the hair above your eyes that protect them from sweat, rain, and sunlight. They also help with facial expressions…
- [Periorbital Region (Area Around Eyes / Orbital Soft Tissues)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/periorbital-region): The periorbital region is the area around your eyes, including skin, fat, muscles, and connective tissue. This delicate area shows age first becaus…
- [Lateral Canthus (Outer Corner / Temporal Canthus)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/lateral-canthus): The lateral canthus is the outer corner of your eye where your upper and lower eyelids meet on the side closest to your temple. This area is import…
- [Medial Canthus (Inner Corner / Nasal Canthus)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/medial-canthus): The medial canthus is the inner corner of your eye, closest to your nose. This area contains the tear drainage system (lacrimal puncta) that remove…
- [Limbus (Corneal-Scleral Border / Limbal Region)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/limbus-cornea): The limbus (limbal region) is the border between your clear cornea and white sclera. This small area contains stem cells that repair and renew your…
- [Photoreceptors (Light-Sensing Cells / Rods and Cones)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/photoreceptors): Photoreceptors are special cells in your retina that sense light and convert it into signals your brain can understand. There are two types: rods (…
- [Palpebral Fissure (Eye Opening / Interpalpebral Space)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/palpebral-fissure): The palpebral fissure is the opening between your upper and lower eyelids—the part of your eye that's visible when your eyes are open. This opening…
- [Eye Socket Floor (Orbital Floor / Infraorbital Region)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/anatomy/orbital-floor-fracture): Your eye socket (orbit) has four walls made of bone, and the floor (infraorbital region) is the bottom wall that supports your eye and eye muscles.…

## Procedures

- [LASIK Eye Surgery (Laser-Assisted In Situ Keratomileusis)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/lasik-surgery): LASIK (Laser-Assisted In Situ Keratomileusis) is an eye surgery that uses a laser to reshape the cornea (clear front of your eye) to fix vision pro…
- [Cataract Surgery (Cataract Extraction)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/cataract-surgery): Cataract Surgery (cataract extraction) removes the cloudy lens inside your eye and replaces it with a clear artificial lens (intraocular lens, or I…
- [PRK Laser Surgery (Photorefractive Keratectomy)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/prk-laser-surgery): PRK (Photorefractive Keratectomy) is a laser surgery that reshapes the cornea to fix vision problems. It's similar to LASIK but uses a different te…
- [SMILE Laser Surgery (Small Incision Lenticule Extraction)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/smile-laser-surgery): SMILE (Small Incision Lenticule Extraction) is a newer laser surgery that reshapes the cornea through a tiny incision to fix myopia and astigmatism…
- [Retinal Detachment Surgery (Retinal Reattachment)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/retinal-detachment-surgery): Retinal Detachment Surgery (retinal reattachment) reattaches the retina (light-sensing tissue) back to the eye wall to restore vision. this surgery…
- [Glaucoma Surgery (Glaucoma Filtration / Aqueous Outflow Surgery)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/glaucoma-surgery): Glaucoma Surgery (glaucoma filtration or aqueous outflow surgery) improves fluid drainage from the eye to lower intraocular pressure (IOP). glaucom…
- [Corneal Transplant (Corneal Graft / Keratoplasty)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/corneal-transplant): A Corneal Transplant (corneal graft, or keratoplasty) replaces diseased or damaged corneal tissue with healthy tissue from a donor. a corneal trans…
- [Eyelid Surgery (Blepharoplasty / Oculoplastic Surgery)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/eyelid-surgery): Eyelid Surgery (blepharoplasty, or oculoplastic surgery) fixes eyelid problems like drooping, puffiness, or positioning issues. eyelid surgery corr…
- [Dry Eye Treatment Procedures](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/dry-eye-treatment-procedures): Various procedures treat severe dry eye when drops aren't enough. These improve tear production or seal tear ducts.
- [Vitrectomy (Gel Removal from Eye)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/vitrectomy-gel-removal): Vitrectomy removes the gel (vitreous) from the eye. This is used to treat retinal problems, bleeding, or severe floaters.
- [Photorefractive Keratoplasty (PRK)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/photorefractive-keratoplasty): PRK uses excimer laser to reshape the cornea surface. It corrects myopia, hyperopia, and astigmatism without corneal flap.
- [Intraocular Lens Implant](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/intraocular-lens-implant): An intraocular lens (IOL) is an artificial lens implanted in the eye during cataract surgery or refractive surgery.
- [Laser Eye Surgery Overview](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/laser-eye-surgery-overview): Laser eye surgery uses focused light beams to reshape the cornea or treat eye conditions. Many types available.
- [Conductive Keratoplasty (CK)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/conductive-keratoplasty): CK uses radiofrequency energy to reshape the cornea. It's useful for correcting presbyopia or mild refractive errors.
- [YAG Capsulotomy (Laser Capsule Opening)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/yag-capsulotomy): YAG capsulotomy uses a laser to open the cloudy capsule behind an implanted lens. It's done in office and restores vision.
- [Refractive Lens Exchange (Clear Lens Exchange / Lens Replacement Surgery)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/refractive-lens-exchange): Refractive Lens Exchange (clear lens exchange, or lens replacement surgery) removes your clear natural lens and replaces it with an artificial intr…
- [Femtosecond Laser Surgery (Femto LASIK / All-Laser LASIK)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/femtosecond-laser-surgery): Femtosecond Laser Surgery (femto LASIK, or all-laser LASIK) uses an ultra-precise laser to reshape the cornea for vision correction with greater ac…
- [Corneal Cross-Linking (CXL / Riboflavin Therapy)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/corneal-cross-linking): Corneal Cross-Linking (CXL, or riboflavin therapy) uses riboflavin drops and UV light to strengthen corneal tissue, treating conditions like kerato…
- [Implantable Contact Lens (ICL / Phakic IOL)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/implantable-contact-lens): An Implantable Contact Lens (ICL, or phakic IOL) is a permanent prescription lens implanted inside your eye in front of your natural lens to correc…
- [Pterygium Removal (Pterygium Excision / Tissue Grafting)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/pterygium-removal): Pterygium Removal (pterygium excision, or tissue grafting) surgically removes the pterygium (fleshy growth) from the eye surface to improve appeara…
- [Advanced Surface Ablation (ASA / TPRK / Surface Laser)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/arc-advanced-surface-ablation): Advanced Surface Ablation (ASA, TPRK, or surface laser) uses a laser to reshape the cornea surface without creating a flap, suitable for thin corneas.
- [Intacs Corneal Implant (Corneal Inlays / Intracorneal Ring Segments)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/intacs-corneal-implant): Intacs Corneal Implant (corneal inlays, or intracorneal ring segments) places small plastic rings or lenses inside the cornea to improve vision in…
- [Limbal Relaxing Incisions (LRI / Astigmatic Keratotomy)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/limbal-relaxing-incisions): Limbal Relaxing Incisions (LRI, or astigmatic keratotomy) are small incisions in the eye to reduce astigmatism by flattening the cornea.
- [Epithelial Ingrowth Removal (Flap Complication Treatment)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/procedures/epithelial-ingrowth-removal): Epithelial Ingrowth Removal treats a rare LASIK complication where cells grow under the corneal flap, requiring surgical removal.

## Treatments

- [Glasses (Eyeglasses)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/glasses-prescription): Glasses are lenses that help focus light properly on the retina. They correct myopia, hyperopia, astigmatism, and presbyopia.
- [Contact Lenses](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/contact-lenses): Contact lenses are small, curved pieces placed directly on the eye. They correct the same vision errors as glasses.
- [Eye Drops and Lubricants](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/eye-drops-lubricants): Eye drops are liquid medications or lubricants applied to the eye. They treat dryness, allergies, infection, and other conditions.
- [Eye Vitamins and Supplements](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/eye-vitamins-supplements): Eye vitamins contain nutrients proven to support eye health. They may slow age-related vision changes.
- [Computer Vision Syndrome Management](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/computer-vision-management): Computer vision syndrome (digital eye strain) is managed through habits, breaks, and glasses if needed.
- [Protective Eyewear](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/protective-eyewear): Protective eyewear shields eyes from injury during sports, work, or hazardous activities.
- [Sunglasses and UV Protection](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/sunglasses-uv): UV protective sunglasses prevent eye damage from sun exposure. They protect against cataracts and macular degeneration.
- [Antihistamine Eye Drops (Antiallergic Medications)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/antihistamine-eye-drops): Antihistamine Eye Drops (antiallergic medications) reduce itching, redness, and swelling caused by allergic reactions. antihistamine drops quickly…
- [Steroid Eye Drops (Topical Corticosteroids)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/steroid-eye-drops): Steroid Eye Drops (topical corticosteroids) reduce inflammation and swelling in the eye for conditions like uveitis or post-surgical inflammation.…
- [Orthokeratology (Overnight Lenses)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/orthokeratology-night-lenses): Ortho-K lenses gently reshape the cornea while you sleep. Clear vision during the day without glasses.
- [Eye Exercises and Vision Therapy](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/eye-exercises-vision-therapy): Eye exercises strengthen eye muscles and improve focusing ability for certain vision problems.
- [Rigid Gas-Permeable Contact Lenses (RGP Lenses / Oxygen-Permeable Hard Lenses)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/rigid-gas-permeable-lenses): Rigid Gas-Permeable Contact Lenses (RGP lenses, or oxygen-permeable hard lenses) are durable contacts that let oxygen reach your eye while correcti…
- [Toric Contact Lenses (Cylindrical Correction Lenses)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/toric-contact-lenses): Toric Contact Lenses (cylindrical correction lenses) are specially shaped to correct astigmatism alongside myopia or hyperopia. toric lenses correc…
- [Multifocal Contact Lenses (Progressive Correction Lenses)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/multifocal-contact-lenses): Multifocal Contact Lenses (progressive correction lenses) have different prescription strengths in different areas to correct presbyopia and other…
- [Cyclosporine Eye Drops (Immunosuppressant Drops / Topical Immunotherapy)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/cyclosporine-eye-drops): Cyclosporine Eye Drops (immunosuppressant drops, or topical immunotherapy) reduce inflammation and increase tear production for severe dry eye.
- [Botulinum Toxin Injections (Botox for Eyes / Muscle Paralysis)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/botulinum-toxin-injections): Botulinum Toxin Injections (Botox for eyes, or muscle paralysis) relax overactive eye muscles to treat conditions like spasms or involuntary blinking.
- [Photodynamic Therapy (PDT / Avastin for Wet AMD)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/photodynamic-therapy): Photodynamic Therapy (PDT, or drug-light treatment) uses a light-sensitive drug and laser to destroy abnormal blood vessels in age-related macular…
- [Oral Glaucoma Medications (Acetazolamide / Systemic Drugs)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/oral-medications-glaucoma): Oral Glaucoma Medications (acetazolamide, or systemic drugs) are taken by mouth to reduce intraocular pressure when eye drops alone are insufficient.
- [Vitamin Supplementation for Eye Health (AREDS / Nutritional Supplements)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/vitamin-supplementation): Vitamin Supplementation for Eye Health (AREDS, or nutritional supplements) provides antioxidants and minerals to slow age-related macular degenerat…
- [Protective Eyewear (Safety Glasses / Sports Goggles / UV Protection)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/protective-eyewear): Protective Eyewear (safety glasses, sports goggles, or UV protection) shields your eyes from injury, UV rays, and environmental hazards.
- [Lubricating Ointments (Ocular Ointments / Night-Time Lubrication)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/lubricating-ointments): Lubricating Ointments (ocular ointments, or night-time lubrication) provide longer-lasting moisture for severe dry eye, especially at night.
- [Anti-Inflammatory Medications (NSAIDs / Corticosteroids for Eyes)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/anti-inflammatory-medications): Anti-Inflammatory Medications (NSAIDs, or corticosteroids for eyes) reduce swelling and inflammation in the eye from various causes.
- [Vision Training Exercises (Eye Exercises / Vision Therapy)](https://silmatervis.ksa.ee/treatments/vision-training-exercises): Vision Training Exercises (eye exercises, or vision therapy) strengthen eye muscles and improve visual skills for conditions like amblyopia or conv…
